title: refactor(components)!: retire the unused ViewSkeleton dispatcher and ShimmerSkeleton
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8MCjwDfBRBbh1qJBm2tbXAr)_

Fixes #25915

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:从 `@object-ui/components` 的发布入口删掉两个没人用的组件:`ViewSkeleton`(按 variant 分发的骨架屏包装,连同它的两个类型)和 `ShimmerSkeleton`(连同其 props 类型)。
- 为什么改:裁决 B 收尾本卡;两者在整个工作区零导入,只是挂在公开面上的死导出。
- 风险与回滚:对外是破坏性变更(外部宿主若导入会编译失败),changeset 带 BREAKING 说明与逐个 FROM → TO 迁移;仓内零调用方。回滚即恢复两处导出。`GridSkeleton` 等其余骨架屏照常导出。
- 先看:`ui/packages/components/src/custom/view-skeleton.tsx`(只删分发器);`.changeset/25915-retire-view-and-shimmer-skeleton.md`(迁移说明与 ADR-0087 标记)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -nwE "ViewSkeleton|ShimmerSkeleton" -- ui ':!*CHANGELOG.md'`,预期零命中。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(合并前需 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 契约复核,席位转交分诊)。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/components/src/custom/view-skeleton.tsx`: the `ViewSkeleton` variant dispatcher leaves, with `ViewSkeletonVariant` and `ViewSkeletonDispatchProps`. The file stays and keeps exporting `GridSkeleton`, `KanbanSkeleton`, `FormSkeleton`, `ListSkeleton`, `ChartSkeleton` and the `ViewSkeletonProps` / `GridSkeletonProps` / `KanbanSkeletonProps` types. `GridSkeleton` and `ChartSkeleton` have live importers (`plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-charts`).
- `ui/packages/components/src/custom/shimmer-skeleton.tsx` is deleted (`ShimmerSkeleton`, `ShimmerSkeletonProps`), and so is its `custom/index.ts` line.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/styles.css`: the `animate-shimmer` usage comment no longer points at `ShimmerSkeleton`. The keyframe and utility stay.
- Changeset `@object-ui/components` `patch`: a BREAKING note, a FROM → TO line for each of the five retired exports, and an `adr-0087: not-required (runtime-export-retired …)` marker naming all five. `patch` because `Metadata-protocol: none` (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3: a non-protocol change, breaking included, ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner).

Not touched, per ruling B (6486367718): `KanbanSkeleton`, `FormSkeleton` and `ListSkeleton` lose their only caller (the dispatcher) but stay exported. The Studio empty states and `DataEmptyState` are not touched either.

## Tests

No new test. The removal is proven once on the built package (below), not pinned by a permanent file. The claim's file surface names no test file.

## Acceptance notes

- Owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` contract review of the whole non-prose diff before the queue: `pm-dispatch` `references/contract-review.md` puts a `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` declaration at that tier. The seat hands it to triage. It is not Tier H, because no governed path is touched.
- ADR-0145 does not govern this: it covers `?: never` tombstones on the ui authoring face, not React runtime exports.

## Verification

All readings at head `8e055464` (base `c4c515ad`, #27366's merge).

<details><summary>Build, type-check, tests and the removal proof</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components build` under `os-verify-lock`: VERDICT command-exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check`: VERDICT command-exit 0, 0 `error TS`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/` under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 447 passed | 1 skipped (448), Tests 4327 passed | 24 skipped. This includes `chart-primitives-removed-7397.test.ts`, which reads the package barrel and requires `ChartSkeleton` to stay exported.
- Removal proof on the built `dist/`: `grep -cw` reads 0 for each of `ViewSkeleton`, `ViewSkeletonVariant`, `ViewSkeletonDispatchProps`, `ShimmerSkeleton` and `ShimmerSkeletonProps`, in `index.js` and in `custom/view-skeleton.d.ts`. `custom/shimmer-skeleton.d.ts` is not emitted, and `custom/index.d.ts` has no shimmer line. Control: `GridSkeleton` reads 2 in `custom/view-skeleton.d.ts` and 1 in `index.js`.
- Importers before the change, `git grep -w` over `ui`, `packages`, `apps` and `examples` (CHANGELOGs and the two files themselves excluded): 0 for all five. The only other hit was the `styles.css` comment this PR rewords.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0, with no anchored file in the change set.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates and dogfood</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 28 families. All 28 ran, each with its exit code captured before any pipe, and all exited 0. `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` verified the `runtime-export-retired` marker for all five operands. `--ran` reconciliation: 28 derived, 28 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` first read 1 failed. The failure was `quick-reference-commands-4149` naming `apps/site`: a leftover `ui/apps/site` directory holding only ignored files from this worktree's install, before #27329 retired the site on `main`. With the directory removed, the rerun gave VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 169 passed | 2 skipped.
- `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate. Changed lines: 111 (+21 / -90).
- Full dogfood, required because the title carries `!` and Clause-② has the `(narrowing)` arm. The closure was built with `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build` (VERDICT 0), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` ran under the lock with no shard and no path: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 348 passed | 3 skipped (351), Tests 2806 passed | 20 skipped (2826).

</details>
